method: Direct visual review of current main canonical WebP files after targeted replacements. Kept items are accepted when the image correctly represents the subject even if an older automatic low-resolution/dark flag exists. Legitimate same-dish reuse is explicitly allowed. Generic substitute photos are labeled representative rather than region-exact.
